name: Calendar
description: Upcoming events from an ICS feed
complete-description:
Upcoming events from any ICS feed — the export format almost every calendar (Google, Outlook, Apple, Nextcloud) can produce. Leads with a plain count of what's coming up, since that's the one thing worth reading from across a room, then lists individual events as the tile has room for them.

Unlike Weather or Disk Space, there's nothing here to reorder — every row is the same kind of thing, one event — so a larger tile simply shows more of them, up to a limit you set.
